scope: Only new host/harness-lifecycle-144 artifacts and mutable GOAL/receipt follow-up metadata; no frozen electrical or runner edits
parent_corrections: Propagate command exit codes, preserve original child return code in receipt and map signals separately.
Resolve executable before cwd change and actually execute the resolved path.
Reserve output receipt exclusively before launch; reject infinite timeout.
Cleanup whole process group even after leader exit and on orchestration exceptions, with TERM-to-KILL escalation.
Require process-table tests to reject permission errors; verify target PIDs are gone rather than relying on absent marker files.
dedicated_review: Targeted parent code and test review due unrelated branch work; Luna supplied lifecycle audit and initial implementation. Parent corrected final code.
future_rule: Wrap future launch/archive commands with command_guard run using explicit timeout, cwd, and new receipt. Use command_guard hash only on explicit file lists. Do not rerun historical frozen output scripts.
limitations: Guard cannot survive its own SIGKILL or host failure.
Children that deliberately escape the dedicated process group are outside its cleanup contract.
No change to timestamp acceptance policy or electrical criteria; selected model gaps remain.
